channel.description: Latest articles from Best Little Sites (comicbookmovie.com)

item.title: WONDER MAN Stars And Creators Break Down Season Finale, Reveal Alternate Ending
item.description: Wonder Man stars Yahya Abdul-Mateen II and Sir Ben Kingsley and creators Andrew Guest and Destin Daniel Cretton break down the season finale and revealed a scrapped ending for the show.

item.title: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY Leaked Story Details Reveal Plans For Steve Rogers, Thor, Doctor Doom, More
item.description: Rumoured Avengers: Doomsday story details reveal more about the movie's first act and what the plan is for characters like Doctor Doom, Steve Rogers, and Thor.

item.title: HOW TO TRAIN YOUR DRAGON 2 Starts Filming As Cate Blanchett & Ólafur Darri Ólafsson Join Cast
item.description: Filming is underway on the next chapter in Universal's live-action How to Train Your Dragon film series, and we have a slew of casting announements as well as the first production photo!

item.title: WONDER MAN Creators Explain Josh Gad And Joe Pantoliano's Meta MCU Cameos
item.description: Wonder Man creators Andrew Guest and Destin Daniel Cretton explain Josh Gad and Joe Pantoliano's meta cameos in the Disney+ series, including how they approached their fictionalised counterparts.

item.title: TED LASSO Star Phil Dunster Replaces Kit Harington In HOW TO TRAIN YOUR DRAGON 2
item.description: Ted Lasso standout Phil Dunster is the latest addition to the cast of How to Train Your Dragon 2, and he's taking over the role of Eret from Kit Harington.

item.title: 7 DCEU Projects We Wish Had Been Made Before DC Studios Rebooted The Franchise
item.description: DC Studios scrapped the DCEU at the start of 2023 for a much-needed reboot, but there are a handful of unmade movies from that time we wish had become a reality.

item.title: GOD OF WAR Casts SEVERANCE Star Ólafur Darri Ólafsson As Thor; HOMELAND's Mandy Patinkin To Play Odin
item.description: The upcoming God of War TV series has cast Severance star Ólafur Darri Ólafsson as Thor, a role filled by Kratos actor Ryan Hurst in the hit video game franchise. Odin has also been cast.

item.title: RRR Director S. S. Rajamouli Sets 2027 Release Date For Globetrotting Epic VARANASI
item.description: After setting the world ablaze with RRR a few years ago, acclaimed director S. S. Rajamouli is ready to return to the silver screen with a new globe trotting epic: Varanasi, which hits theaters 2027!

item.title: SPIDER-MAN: BRAND NEW DAY Crew Merch Reveals New Look At Tom Holland's Web-Slinger
item.description: Crew merchandise for Spider-Man: Brand New Day has been revealed, and it features a shadowy look at the wall-crawler in a movie Tom Holland has described as "creatively fulfilling."
